fusions.name: Running Shot
fusions.desc: Fires from the saddle, dealing 30 damage to the first enemy it hits and ignoring its armour. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you fire.

fusions.name: Powder-Flash Spook
fusions.desc: The report sets you rearing, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Cocked and Ready
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Loaded at the Gallop
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
